issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without percent-encoding, allowing '/', '?', and '#' to change the requested endpoint.
Transport-level failures such as timeouts and connection resets are not retried or wrapped in client exceptions.
Retry-After parsing only supports numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date header values.
Pagination trusts response shape without validating JSON type, items type, or cursor progress.
BatchItemResult accepts invalid statuses and inconsistent task/error combinations from API responses.
ReviewResult.from_dict does not validate verdict values despite the Verdict literal type.
Scripted mock responses bypass API-key validation, so tests can accidentally pass unauthenticated flows.
The package advertises type hints but does not ship a PEP 561 py.typed marker for downstream type checkers.
The package version is duplicated with lumen/__init__.py and can drift without tooling.
